verdict.rationale: Dynadot documents dedicated bulk search, where you paste a list and add all available names to the cart in one click. It also documents bulk transfer of many domains at once, folder-wide domain adjustments via smart folders, and an API pitched for large bulk adjustments, including register, transfer and renew commands. Bulk renewal and bulk nameserver changes are only implied through the API and folder-wide adjustments, never explicitly documented as bulk features. missing for 10: explicit bulk renewal and bulk nameserver-change documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk operations at scale.

support.subject: As a power user managing a portfolio, bulk operations are real — bulk search, registration, renewal, nameserver changes, and transfers across many domains at once
